India’s stock market suffered a massive sell-off, wiping out ₹7.4 lakh crore in market value as global pressures hit Dalal Street. The Sensex plunged over 1,100 points, while the Nifty fell below 23,000, with banking stocks and foreign investor outflows adding to the pressure.
From soaring crude oil prices and the Strait of Hormuz crisis to rising US Treasury yields and America’s mounting debt, global developments are increasingly spilling over into Indian markets.
